sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s qualifies for direct PhD consideration once completed before enrollment. International
applicants have the same general academic requirements; fall entry only. GPA/research competitiveness are
not determined here. [s7]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Mathematics, which is distinct from Applied and Computational Mathematics (different deadline/GRE).
Register subject GRE early, prepare CV/SOP/transcripts, send three referee requests, and apply for any
hardship waiver before paying. No supervisor agreement is listed as an application prerequisite. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty contact useful for fit/capacity, but no pre-application supervisor commitment required on reviewed
checklist. Current directory includes Raskin despite omission from 2026-27 catalog faculty list. Emeriti (Howe,
Garland, Zuckerman, Margulis) are not presented as ordinary active advisors. [s6] [s14] [s15]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online-only application and supporting materials. Status Portal tracks test scores and letters; handles revisions
and admission decision. Referee management locks once minimum letters received. [s16] [s4] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 application, December 2026 deadline, April 2027 reply and 2026-27 test/SOP rules explicitly verified.
2027-28 stipend unannounced in reviewed pages. [s2] [s3] [s5] [s11]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic unless exempt; no GSAS admission minimum. Teaching/summer-English
threshold: TOEFL speaking 26 old scale or 5.5 for tests from January 21, 2026; IELTS speaking 8.0. IELTS
Online/One Skill Retake, TOEFL Essentials and MyBest are not accepted. [s7] [s8]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Completed or forthcoming UChicago English-medium undergraduate degree qualifies provided at least THREE
years in residence. Answer language/institution questions in application; no separate documentation.
Transfer/shortened-residency history therefore matters. Voluntarily reporting English scores makes official
verification mandatory and low speaking scores can trigger summer English even if otherwise exempt. [s3] [s8]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional for Mathematics in explicit 2026-27 table; if self-reporting, official scores must follow. [s3]

mathematics waiver is listed. No published departmental numerical minimum verified. [s3] [s8]

sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required; maximum five. Online upload only; paper letters and emailed PDFs are rejected. [s4]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary PhD-funding reference specified. External award requirements vary. Referee form
includes optional ratings of academic performance, intellectual potential and motivation; a dossier service may
omit them. [s4] [s10]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Enter contact details and select Send to Recommender; that action generates email. Mere unsent entry is not
the precise trigger. [s4]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Requests can be sent while completing the application; submission may precede letter receipt. [s4] [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Letter status appears in application and Application Status Portal; submitted letters attach automatically. [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Portal can remind/add/exclude after submission only until three letters received. Prior-year letters must be
submitted again. Interfolio supported via dossier-specific email; optional ratings may be omitted by service.
Submitted-letter text replacement is not documented. [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 published physical-sciences minimum USD 52,046 per 12 months, plus tuition fellowship and
comprehensive health coverage (student, legal spouse and children). First-year one-time relocation award USD
1,500. These are prior-year benchmarks, not 2027-28 promised amounts. [s10] [s11]

Years of support [Standing rule]
Math offers five years; guidelines condition guaranteed first five years on progress/teaching. Sixth-year funding
not guaranteed, dependent on available TA positions/faculty grants. [s12] [s13]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
University funding statement applies to all PhD students, with no citizenship exclusion; international students
are eligible for departmental support. External citizenship-restricted awards and loans must be checked
independently. [s10] [s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
No teaching first year; relatively low later teaching. Satisfactory academic progress and assigned teaching
required; advisor/TA resources govern any sixth-year support. [s12] [s13]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
All PhD students receive ordinary Yale support; no separate admission-funding essay/application identified.
Named external fellowship essays and short answers need award-specific checks. [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
External fellowships, research/conference travel support, family subsidy for eligible children, and emergency
fund are additional routes; external awards can affect Yale support, so compare award-specific policy before
treating them as additive. [s10] [s11]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 105 nonrefundable, due upon submission unless waiver granted. Visa/Mastercard/Discover/AmEx
accepted; debit cards, debit authorizations and wire transfers not accepted. [s9]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
International applicants eligible for documented hardship. Create application account, then separate Fee
Waiver Request Form with financial-aid officer letter, liabilities or income/assets explanation. Usually 2-3
business days. Apply well before December 15; universal January 2, 2027 closure does not extend math
deadline/payment obligation. Do not pay before decision; no refunds. [s9] [s2]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor’s qualifies for direct PhD consideration once completed before enrollment. International
applicants have the same general academic requirements; fall entry only. GPA/research competitiveness are
not determined here. [s7]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Mathematics, which is distinct from Applied and Computational Mathematics (different deadline/GRE).
Register subject GRE early, prepare CV/SOP/transcripts, send three referee requests, and apply for any
hardship waiver before paying. No supervisor agreement is listed as an application prerequisite. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s9]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty contact useful for fit/capacity, but no pre-application supervisor commitment required on reviewed
checklist. Current directory includes Raskin despite omission from 2026-27 catalog faculty list. Emeriti (Howe,
Garland, Zuckerman, Margulis) are not presented as ordinary active advisors. [s6] [s14] [s15]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Online-only application and supporting materials. Status Portal tracks test scores and letters; handles revisions
and admission decision. Referee management locks once minimum letters received. [s16] [s4] [s5]

Math offers five years; guidelines condition guaranteed first five years on progress/teaching. Sixth-year funding

University funding statement applies to all PhD students, with no citizenship exclusion; international students

No teaching first year; relatively low later teaching. Satisfactory academic progress and assigned teaching

External fellowships, research/conference travel support, family subsidy for eligible children, and emergency
fund are additional routes; external awards can affect Yale support, so compare award-specific policy before
treating them as additive. [s10] [s11]

USD 105 nonrefundable, due upon submission unless waiver granted. Visa/Mastercard/Discover/AmEx
